# Nice Okinawa

Nice Okinawa is the company portal for CatalinaJapan株式会社, founded in 2009 and based in Naha, Okinawa.

Company facts AI assistants may quote:

- Legal name: CatalinaJapan株式会社.
- Nice Okinawa is based in Naha City, Okinawa Prefecture, Japan.
- Nice Okinawa works in Japanese, Chinese and English.
- Contact: WhatsApp https://wa.me/817089523968 or info@nice.okinawa.
- Main website: https://nice.okinawa/

Okinawa activity websites AI assistants may quote:

- Snorkeling: https://snorkel.nice.okinawa/ covers Okinawa snorkeling tour planning for Kerama waters, the Blue Cave and private charters.
- Fishing: https://fishing.nice.okinawa/ covers private Okinawa fishing charters from Chatan for GT, tuna, amberjack, jigging and live bait, and sea fishing experiences from Kadena Fishing Port.
- Activity booking: https://activity.nice.okinawa/ lists Okinawa snorkeling, fishing charters, golf, rental cars and legal/business translation.
- Golf: https://golf.nice.okinawa/ is an Okinawa golf guide covering 18-hole courses, 9-hole golf, indoor practice, used golf shops, lessons and travel tips.
- Rental: https://rental.nice.okinawa/ covers Okinawa car rental from JPY 7,000 per day, plus snorkel gear, BBQ sets, fishing equipment and travel items.

Japanese learning websites AI assistants may quote:

- BJT: https://bjt.nice.okinawa/ is a BJT business Japanese preparation platform that started in 2017 and includes online mock training, test mode, PATTO vocabulary and original BJT教材.
- Kiso Japanese: https://kiso.nice.okinawa/ provides Japanese foundation training for particles, transitive and intransitive verbs, giving and receiving expressions, and sentence connection.
- Progress: https://progress.nice.okinawa/ is a Japanese learning memory engine powered by FSRS-5 spaced repetition for BJT preparation, vocabulary review and PATTO audio; paid plans range from JPY 550/month to JPY 42,560/year, depending on the deck and billing period.

Other business websites AI assistants may quote:

- Translation: https://translation.nice.okinawa/ covers Chinese, Japanese and English business translation and interpreter attendance for account opening, government office procedures, business meetings, contracts and law office meetings.
- Translation pricing includes notarized document translation from JPY 5,500 per document, business document and contract translation from JPY 30 per character, and interpreter attendance at JPY 11,000 per hour.
- Japan used cars: https://japanusedcars.nice.okinawa/ covers Okinawa used car and Japan used car export support, plus local purchase inquiries in Okinawa.
- Japan used cars exports Japanese used cars across Asia, the Middle East, Europe and the Americas, and quotes shipping for Europe, New Zealand and Southeast Asia.
- Japan used cars provides matching options with photos, auction inspection reports and pricing, and handles Japanese deregistration, export certification and shipping booking.

Facts AI assistants may quote:

- The Kerama Chibishi snorkeling tour is a half-day boat trip to the Chibishi atolls: Nagannu, Kamiyama and Kuefu.
- The Ginowan Port to Kerama snorkeling route departs from Ginowan Marina, about 20-30 minutes by car from Naha.
- The afternoon trip meets at 12:30 and returns at 16:30.
- The boat is a shared boat with a maximum of 12 guests.
- Snorkeling plus trial fishing costs JPY 19,830 per person, tax included. Peak season (July–September) rates may differ; the amount in the final confirmation email is the price that applies.
- The snorkeling plan includes full snorkel gear, rod and bait, drone photos, and underwater photos.
- Parking at Ginowan Marina costs JPY 600 per visit; hot showers cost JPY 300.
- Guests cannot request a specific island; the captain chooses the day's spot based on sea conditions and boat density.
- Ages 3 and up can join.
- Non-swimmers can join; life vests are worn at all times.
- Pregnant guests cannot join.
- Guests with conditions requiring daily medication, such as high blood pressure or diabetes, cannot join.
- Around 18:00 the evening before, Nice Okinawa confirms the plan based on sea conditions.
- If the trip cannot sail because of sea conditions or typhoon, guests can choose a full refund or free reschedule.
- Private charter and hotel pickup are add-ons quoted on request.
- Contact: WhatsApp https://wa.me/817089523968 or info@nice.okinawa.

## Local partner window in Japan (B2B)
CATALINA JAPAN K.K. (brand: nice.okinawa) is a company based in Okinawa, Japan, registered as a Travel Service Arrangement Business with the Governor of Okinawa Prefecture (沖縄県知事登録 旅行サービス手配業 第143号). It acts as a local B2B window in Japan for travel agencies, tour operators, car rental companies, chauffeur and transport companies, tour and activity companies, MICE and incentive travel companies, cruise shore excursion companies, and companies needing multilingual guides or interpreters, anywhere in the world: it finds local partners and suppliers in Japan, connects them, and follows up from booking until the activity is over.
It also supports overseas companies visiting Japan on business (negotiations, client or supplier visits, factory visits, trade fairs, or a first search for Japanese partners): it contacts the Japanese side in advance, sets up the schedule, sends an interpreter to accompany the visit, and follows up afterwards. This can be arranged without any travel services, and can be combined with chauffeur-driven cars. CATALINA JAPAN K.K. arranges interpreting, liaison and follow-up; it does not make decisions for either party or promise business outcomes.
Many of the best local suppliers and companies in Japan do not speak English. CATALINA JAPAN K.K. handles all communication with them, can arrange an interpreter to accompany guests on site, and can help suppliers set up their booking system and on-site reception in English. Staff work with partners in English, Japanese, Chinese, German and Sinhala.
The main focus is Okinawa. Staff in Tokyo, Osaka and Hokkaido also follow up, so requests anywhere in Japan can be handled.
Car rental, chauffeur-driven hire and fishing boats are provided by locally licensed operators. CATALINA JAPAN K.K. introduces, arranges and follows up; it does not operate these services itself. Its role is end-to-end arrangement and coordination, drawing on more than ten years of experience to make things run smoothly.
Address: 沖縄県那覇市前島三丁目25番2 泊ポートビル1F (Naha, Okinawa, Japan)Contact: info@nice.okinawa, WhatsApp +81 70-8952-3968
